title: Three people, three ways
odia:
ଅଗା, ବଗା, ଖଗା
ତିନିହେଁ ତିନି ଅଲଗା ।
literal_meaning: Aga, Baga and Khaga: all three are different from one another.
explanation: Being grouped together does not make people alike. The little series of names makes difference easy to remember; the particular disagreement depends on the occasion.
meaning_odia: ତିନି ଜଣ ଏକାଠି ରହିଲେ ବି ତିନି ଜଣଙ୍କ ଭାବନା ବା ଢଙ୍ଗ ଏକ ହୋଇଯାଏନାହିଁ। ନାଁଗୁଡ଼ିକର ମିଳ ସହ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ଅମେଳକୁ ରଖିବାରୁ କଥାଟି ମନେ ରହେ। ଏକ ଦଳର ସବୁ ଲୋକକୁ ଏକା ଭଳି ଭାବିବା ବଦଳରେ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଗତ ତଫାତ ଦେଖିବାର ଅବସର ଏଥିରେ ଅଛି।
usage_example: Three friends planning a journey each prefer a different destination. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: A literal, bounded editorial reading; the source supplies no origin story or named real individuals.
